# @gears-frontx/ui-kit

> Standard React component base for FrontX templates. Behavior comes from
> Base UI primitives, styling is compiled CSS on semantic design tokens,
> variants via a `variant`/`size` prop pair. Consumers need no CSS framework
> or build plugins.

Rules for generated code:

- Import the design tokens exactly once at the app entry:
  `import '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/theme.css';`
- Import components from the package root: `import { Button } from '@gears-frontx/ui-kit';`
  Each component ships its own CSS, pulled in automatically by importing the
  component — there is no separate stylesheet import for component styles.
  A component subpath also works (`import { Button } from '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/button';`)
  and is the one to reach for on an esbuild-based build specifically: esbuild
  tree-shakes unused components' JS from a root import already, but only
  drops their CSS from a subpath import — Vite and webpack drop both either
  way, so this only matters when esbuild is the actual bundler running.
- The kit paints the page itself from its tokens and sets `color-scheme`: with
  no `data-theme` attribute anywhere, `prefers-color-scheme: dark` alone
  yields a correct, legible dark page (background, text, and UA-owned
  surfaces like the scrollbar) out of the box — no setup step required for
  that case.
- Set the app font AND, for explicit control instead of following the OS
  preference, `data-theme` on `<html>`/`<body>`, not on an inner container:
  overlay components (Select, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tooltip, Toaster) portal
  their popup to `<body>` and inherit theme tokens and font from there. A
  `data-theme` subtree (anywhere, not just `<html>`/`<body>`) paints its own
  surface, not just its descendants' tokens, so it can be nested inside a
  page carrying the opposite theme. If a subtree must carry its own theme,
  pass that element as `container` to `SelectContent` / `DialogContent` /
  `DropdownMenuContent` / `TooltipContent` / `Toaster`.
- Brand/appearance changes go through theme tokens (CSS variables in
  `theme.css`, light/dark via `data-theme`), never through inline styles or
  overriding kit class names.
- Rounding is a scale derived from `--radius` (`--radius-xs|sm|md|lg|xl`);
  override `--radius` alone and every component follows.
- Per-component docs below list the kit-level props; everything else is the
  underlying native element's props.

## Components

- [Badge](dist/docs/badge.md): small pill-shaped status/count/category
  label; variants default|secondary|destructive|outline|ghost|link; no
  Base UI primitive; `render` (e.g. `<a>`) makes it a clickable tag —
  hover feedback for default|secondary|destructive|outline only appears
  once it is; ghost|link hover unconditionally either way.
- [Button](dist/docs/button.md): action button; variants
  default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link, sizes
  default|sm|lg|icon; render prop for button-semantic actions over a
  real anchor (not a link substitute).
- [Card](dist/docs/card.md): bounded content surface (Card/CardHeader/
  CardTitle/CardDescription/CardAction/CardContent/CardFooter); header
  becomes a two-column/two-row grid automatically when it contains a
  CardAction/CardDescription; sizes default|sm.
- [Checkbox](dist/docs/checkbox.md): on/off tick box for independent
  options; `checked`/`onCheckedChange`; nest inside Label for one click
  target.
- [Dialog](dist/docs/dialog.md): modal overlay for a focused task or
  confirmation (Dialog/DialogTrigger/DialogContent/DialogHeader/
  DialogFooter/DialogTitle/DialogDescription/DialogClose); traps focus,
  closes on Escape/outside click; `DialogContent` takes `container` and
  `showCloseButton`.
- [DropdownMenu](dist/docs/dropdown-menu.md): actions/options anchored to
  a trigger (DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuTrigger/DropdownMenuContent/
  DropdownMenuItem/DropdownMenuCheckboxItem/DropdownMenuRadioGroup+
  DropdownMenuRadioItem/DropdownMenuSeparator/DropdownMenuShortcut/
  DropdownMenuSub+DropdownMenuSubTrigger+DropdownMenuSubContent); item
  variants default|destructive; `DropdownMenuContent` takes `container`.
- [Field](dist/docs/field.md): labelled form field composition
  (Field/FieldLabel/FieldDescription/FieldError); wires ids, htmlFor,
  aria-describedby, and validation display automatically — the default
  way to build forms.
- [Input](dist/docs/input.md): single-line text field; `onValueChange`
  for the string value, `aria-invalid` for the error state; wires into
  Field automatically.
- [Label](dist/docs/label.md): caption for a form control; native
  `<label>` props; associate via `htmlFor` or by nesting the control.
- [RadioGroup](dist/docs/radio-group.md): mutually exclusive options
  (RadioGroup + RadioGroupItem); `value`/`onValueChange` on the group;
  arrow-key navigation built in.
- [Select](dist/docs/select.md): dropdown picking one value from a
  list (Select/SelectTrigger/SelectValue/SelectContent/SelectGroup/
  SelectItem); trigger sizes default|sm; keyboard and typeahead built
  in.
- [Separator](dist/docs/separator.md): thin visual divider between content
  sections; orientation horizontal|vertical (default horizontal); no
  `decorative` prop — pass `aria-hidden="true"` for a purely visual
  divider; not for use inside DropdownMenu/Select popups, which have their
  own separator styling; no portal.
- [Skeleton](dist/docs/skeleton.md): pulsing placeholder shape shown while
  content loads; no Base UI primitive, no variants — size it yourself via
  `className`/`style`; no ARIA of its own, put `role="status"`/`aria-busy`
  on the surrounding container; pulse animation is removed under
  `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; no portal.
- [Switch](dist/docs/switch.md): immediate on/off toggle;
  `checked`/`onCheckedChange`, sizes default|sm; use checkbox for
  submit-time options.
- [Table](dist/docs/table.md): styled native table markup
  (Table/TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter/TableRow/TableHead/TableCell/
  TableCaption); no Base UI primitive, no sorting/filtering/pagination —
  primitive markup only; Table's own wrapper scrolls horizontally and is
  keyboard-reachable (`tabIndex`); size a column via `className`/`style`
  width on TableHead/TableCell; no portal.
- [Tabs](dist/docs/tabs.md): switch between panels sharing the same
  space (Tabs/TabsList/TabsTrigger/TabsContent); list variants
  default|line; orientation horizontal|vertical (default horizontal);
  inactive panels unmount unless `keepMounted`; no portal.
- [Textarea](dist/docs/textarea.md): multi-line text field; native
  `<textarea>` props; grows with content; `aria-invalid` for the error
  state.
- [Toast](dist/docs/toast.md): brief transient notification stacked
  bottom-right; fired imperatively (`toast.add({...})`), not composed as
  JSX; mount `Toaster` once; type-driven icon
  success|info|warning|error|loading, optional action button; `Toaster`
  takes `container`.
- [Tooltip](dist/docs/tooltip.md): visual-only hint on hover/focus of a
  trigger (Tooltip/TooltipTrigger/TooltipContent); optional
  `TooltipProvider` shares delay/grouping across many tooltips;
  `TooltipContent` takes `container`; disabled on touch devices — never
  the only carrier of essential information.
